runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0de758f7fffeQ4spcb61cs34t0] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026:

| Metric | Range |
|---|---|
| **First seen (earliest node)** | 367 ms – 3,440 ms after slot start |
| **Average arrival** | 610 ms – 3,666 ms after slot start |
| **Nodes observed per block** | 156–157 |

The query hit the `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node` table (xatu-cbt dataset, clickhouse-refined datasource). 100 rows returned. `first_seen_ms` is the earliest time any node reported seeing the block relative to the slot start — the fastest block in this sample was slot 14590831 at 367 ms.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_0de758f7fffeQ4spcb61cs34t0] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
The distribution chart is ready:

**URL:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/651f6d8bd81f/75a01e7f-442a-4c7a-8f88-31c43d0f4b97/arrival_histogram.png

It shows the distribution of first-seen block arrival times (in ms after slot start) for all mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026. Most blocks arrive within ~2 s, with the peak around 1.3–1.5 s.
